g.text: threshold = 0.5 | own successful samples | internal models: aggregates, NOT sample-paired
OpenJev 4B: four-run summary timing; local models prefer four-run log averages. 4B valid/error counts are unknown.
* = single-run v1 / 0.5 timing; local models require complete, matched logs; internal models use supplied summaries.
OpenJev 32B / Microsoft Decision-1: supplied single-run timing, including failures; protocols differ.
32B has 27,460 errors / 56,823 rows; quality excludes errors.
N/A = missing quality, undefined metric, or incomplete timing; missing values are not zero.
Descriptive only, not a fair ranking. PII is ordinary binary classification (present vs absent), not masking quality.
Qwen3Guard-Stream-8B: binary safety labels; PII unsupported (historical proxies are audit-only).
Qwen mean latency: log elapsed/processed (failures included); CSV P95: successful requests. No ranking.
Luna: original task-specific presets, no custom prompts (prompt N/A); binary threshold 0.5.
Other models use dataset-specific v1/v2 prompts. Task-definition differences may affect results.
Luna three-dataset reference latency: 181.97 ms (user-measured; timing/weights unspecified).
Per-dataset latency and binary PII: N/A; PII micro-F1 is separate. Scorer versions unverified.
Straiker: supplied v1 aggregates; threshold and model/version N/A (not confirmed as 0.5).
Single-run log elapsed/processed includes failures; JailbreakHub: 1 error. PII: binary classification.
Raw files unverified; own valid samples only, not a sample-aligned ranking.
